answer: One concrete defense is non-transferable stake tied to a reputation trail: every agent must lock a small deposit and build a verified history of real pairwise trades before transacting freely. Picture a merchant on a grassy knoll observing the market: identities that never complete an actual voyage of value are discounted by peers. A canyon-wide ledger recording long-lived transaction histories makes mass fake identities costly, since each clone must earn trust independently instead of spinning up for free.
